description_excerpt: Your impact begins here As Head of Sales, you will lead the sales team that brings Novo’s treatments to people across Vietnam. You will turn the sales budget and forecast into clear plans, develop sales managers and representatives, and keep the team focused on results. As a member of the affiliate management team, you will help shape strategy and growth, so more people living with serious chronic diseases can reach the care they need.
